name: Voidlight Potion Cauldron
tooltip:
Voidlight Potion Cauldron
Item Level 65
Binds to Warband
Use: Place a cauldron that allows party and raid members to take potions of their choosing from among the recipes known by your Warband. Only alchemists with the cauldron recipe will contribute.

The cauldron lasts for 5 min and has 80 charges. Each charge grants 5 potions.
Requires Level 81
Max Stack: 200
Sell Price: 11
